mapper.select: SELECT u.user_id AS userId, u.user_role AS role, u.center_id AS centerId, u.user_email AS email, u.manager_phone_access AS visible FROM users u WHERE u.user_email = #{email} LIMIT 1
SELECT expert_id FROM users WHERE user_id = #{userId}

choose.when: AND ( t.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR t.staff LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR RIGHT( /* MySQL 8+: 비숫자 제거 */ REGEXP_REPLACE(t.phone, '[^0-9]', ''), 4 ) = REGEXP_REPLACE(#{keyword}, '[^0-9]', '') OR SUBSTRING( REGEXP_REPLACE(t.phone, '[^0-9]', ''), 1, 3 ) = REGEXP_REPLACE(#{keyword}, '[^0-9]', '') OR SUBSTRING( REGEXP_REPLACE(t.phone, '[^0-9]', ''), 1, 2 ) = REGEXP_REPLACE(#{keyword}, '[^0-9]', '') )
choose.otherwise: AND ( t.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR t.staff LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR t.phone LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR t.memo LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )

choose.when: ORDER BY (t.promiseAt IS NULL) ASC, -- 예약 있는 것 먼저 t.promiseAt ASC -- 빠른 예약일 먼저

ORDER BY FIELD(t.division, '최초','유효','중복'), FIELD(t.status, '부재1','부재2','부재3','부재4','부재5','기타','결번', '재콜','내방','내방취소','신규','가망','자연풀','카피','거절','없음','회수'), /* 재콜 묶음 내부: 예약 없는 것 뒤로, 예약 빠른 순 */ CASE WHEN t.status IN ('재콜','내방') THEN (t.promiseAt IS NULL) END ASC, CASE WHEN t.status IN ('재콜','내방') THEN t.promiseAt END ASC, /* 재콜 이외: 최신 생성일 우선 */ CASE WHEN t.status NOT IN ('재콜','내방') THEN t.createdAt END
ASC DESC

ORDER BY FIELD(t.status, '부재1','부재2','부재3','부재4','부재5','기타','결번', '재콜','내방','내방취소','신규','가망','자연풀','카피','거절','없음','회수'), CASE WHEN t.status IN ('재콜','내방') THEN (t.promiseAt IS NULL) END ASC, CASE WHEN t.status IN ('재콜','내방') THEN t.promiseAt END ASC, CASE WHEN t.status NOT IN ('재콜','내방') THEN t.createdAt END
ASC DESC

ORDER BY FIELD(t.division, '최초','유효','중복'), t.createdAt
ASC DESC

sql.if: AND (c.customer_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR u.user_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR c.customer_phone LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR c.customer_memo LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )

choose.when: ORDER BY (c.customer_promise_time IS NULL) ASC, c.customer_promise_time ASC

ORDER BY FIELD(c.customer_status, '부재1','부재2','부재3','부재4','부재5','기타','결번', '재콜','내방','내방취소','신규','가망','자연풀','카피','거절','없음','회수'), CASE WHEN c.customer_status IN ('재콜','내방') THEN (c.customer_promise_time IS NULL) END ASC, CASE WHEN c.customer_status IN ('재콜','내방') THEN c.customer_promise_time END ASC, CASE WHEN c.customer_status NOT IN ('재콜','내방') THEN c.customer_created_at END
ASC DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers c JOIN users u ON u.user_id = c.user_id
WHERE c.user_id IN (SELECT user_id FROM users WHERE center_id = #{centerId}) AND c.customer_status != '없음'

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers c JOIN users u ON u.user_id = c.user_id
WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} AND c.customer_status != '없음'

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT c.customer_id AS id, 'CUSTOMER' AS origin, c.customer_created_at AS createdAt, u.user_name AS staff, c.customer_division AS division, c.customer_category AS category, c.customer_name AS name, c.customer_phone AS phone, c.customer_source AS source, c.customer_status AS status, c.customer_prev_status AS prevStatus, c.customer_memo AS memo FROM customers c LEFT JOIN users u ON u.user_id = c.user_id WHERE 1=1 AND c.customer_source IN ( SELECT DISTINCT e.expert_name FROM experts e JOIN users u2 ON u2.expert_id = e.expert_id WHERE u2.center_id = #{centerId} ) AND c.customer_created_at >= #{dateFrom} AND c.customer_created_at < DATE_ADD(#{dateTo}, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
UNION ALL
SELECT d.duplicate_id AS id, 'DUPLICATE' AS origin, d.duplicate_created_at AS createdAt, u2.user_name AS staff, '중복' AS division, d.duplicate_category AS category, d.duplicate_name AS name, c2.customer_phone AS phone, d.duplicate_source AS source, '없음' AS status, NULL AS prevStatus, d.duplicate_memo AS memo FROM customers_duplicate d JOIN customers c2 ON c2.customer_id = d.customer_id LEFT JOIN users u2 ON u2.user_id = c2.user_id WHERE d.duplicate_display = 1 AND d.duplicate_source IN ( SELECT DISTINCT e.expert_name FROM experts e JOIN users u3 ON u3.expert_id = e.expert_id WHERE u3.center_id = #{centerId} ) AND d.duplicate_created_at >= #{dateFrom} AND d.duplicate_created_at < DATE_ADD(#{dateTo}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) ) t WHERE 1=1

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT c.customer_id AS id, 'CUSTOMER' AS origin, c.customer_created_at AS createdAt, u.user_name AS staff, c.customer_division AS division, c.customer_category AS category, c.customer_name AS name, c.customer_phone AS phone, c.customer_source AS source, c.customer_status AS status, c.customer_prev_status AS prevStatus, c.customer_memo AS memo FROM customers c LEFT JOIN users u ON u.user_id = c.user_id WHERE 1=1 AND c.customer_source = (SELECT expert_name FROM experts WHERE expert_id = #{myExpertId}) AND c.customer_created_at >= #{dateFrom} AND c.customer_created_at < DATE_ADD(#{dateTo}, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
UNION ALL
SELECT d.duplicate_id AS id, 'DUPLICATE' AS origin, d.duplicate_created_at AS createdAt, u2.user_name AS staff, '중복' AS division, d.duplicate_category AS category, d.duplicate_name AS name, c2.customer_phone AS phone, d.duplicate_source AS source, '없음' AS status, NULL AS prevStatus, d.duplicate_memo AS memo FROM customers_duplicate d JOIN customers c2 ON c2.customer_id = d.customer_id LEFT JOIN users u2 ON u2.user_id = c2.user_id WHERE d.duplicate_display = 1 AND d.duplicate_source = (SELECT expert_name FROM experts WHERE expert_id = #{myExpertId}) AND d.duplicate_created_at >= #{dateFrom} AND d.duplicate_created_at < DATE_ADD(#{dateTo}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) ) t WHERE 1=1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers WHERE customer_id = #{customerId}
